_comment: Concurrency faults. Run against a ThreadSanitizer build: cmake -S . -B build-tsan -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DAMBAR_SANITIZE=thread, then apply one of these by hand and run ./build-tsan/ambar_tests -v. The two group-commit entries are use-after-return of a Writer on a caller's stack -- a member answered while it watched returns from write() without the mutex, so the frame can be gone the instant its state changes -- and a data race on its status; an AddressSanitizer build with ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_stack_use_after_return=1, as CI runs it, reports the first when the member wins the race, and ThreadSanitizer reports the second. tools/mutate.py drives ./build, so point it at a sanitizer build directory or apply these manually.
